tests.name: complete document skeleton
tests.hint: Same skeleton as always: doctype, html lang, charset, title.

tests.name: one h1 in an hgroup with a subtitle
tests.hint: The subtitle is part of the same heading — it lives in the hgroup, not in a new heading level.

tests.name: outline never skips a level
tests.hint: Walk the headings in document order: each one may step down at most one level from the previous.

tests.name: comments region labelled by its heading
tests.hint: The section borrows its heading as its name: the id lives on the <h2> (or h3), not on a wrapper.

tests.name: nested comment article named by its heading
tests.hint: The innermost article is the comment — it needs its own aria-labelledby pointing at its heading's id.
